typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination1_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		BAL_IN as string,
		CLOSING_BAL_AMT as integer,
		YEAR_END_IND as string,
		EFFDATE as timestamp,
		GL_COMPANY_CD as string,
		EFFECTIVEDATE as integer,
		GL_PRODUCT_CD as string,
		BR_ACCOUNT_NM as string,
		ISO_CURRENCY_CD as string,
		BR_ACCOUNT_CD as string,
		GL_ACCOUNT_CD as string,
		GL_AU_CD as string,
		GL_INVENTORY_CD as string,
		DAILY_BAL_AMT as integer,
		CLIENT_NBR as string,
		BR_BRANCH_CD as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource1
OLEDBSource1 sink(input(
		BAL_IN as string,
		CLOSING_BAL_AMT as integer,
		YEAR_END_IND as string,
		EFFDATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		GL_COMPANY_CD as string,
		EFFECTIVEDATE as integer,
		GL_PRODUCT_CD as string,
		BR_ACCOUNT_NM as string,
		ISO_CURRENCY_CD as string,
		BR_ACCOUNT_CD as string,
		GL_ACCOUNT_CD as string,
		GL_AU_CD as string,
		GL_INVENTORY_CD as string,
		DAILY_BAL_AMT as integer,
		CLIENT_NBR as string,
		BR_BRANCH_CD as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,batchSize: 50176,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		BAL_IN,
		CLOSING_BAL_AMT,
		YEAR_END_IND,
		EFFDATE,
		GL_COMPANY_CD,
		EFFECTIVEDATE,
		GL_PRODUCT_CD,
		BR_ACCOUNT_NM,
		ISO_CURRENCY_CD,
		BR_ACCOUNT_CD,
		GL_ACCOUNT_CD,
		GL_AU_CD,
		GL_INVENTORY_CD,
		DAILY_BAL_AMT,
		CLIENT_NBR,
		BR_BRANCH_CD),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination1_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination1
